primary_source.author: Marc T. Pudelko
primary_source.title: Modular Periodicity of Random Initialized Recurrences
primary_source.sampling_finding: Conjecture 20 gives random integer initialization in Z², but does not specify expanding-square sampling or any other probability law. The source must not be described as explicitly square-uniform.

prior_argument.author: Shivam Patel
prior_argument.attribution: The cone characterization, lattice sum, and 5/24 limit are prior mathematical work credited to Patel. His assertion that the source explicitly specifies square-uniform sampling is not supported by the checked primary source.

outcome_scope: Full formal proof of the 5/24 square-uniform interpretation counterexample, including both strict and tie-inclusive minima. No distribution-independent claim and no claim of new mathematics.

upstream_repository_context.dependency_note: The recurrence/minima proof is self-contained over pinned mathlib; it imports no manuscript theorem or sibling outcome.

formal_validation.qualification: Compilation only; independent review and paper required before counting.
